good.title: Good air
good.description: The air is clean and the level of pollution is minimal or does not pose any health risk. It is safe for most people.

satisfactory.title: Satisfactory air
satisfactory.description: Air quality is generally acceptable for most people, but some pollutants may pose a moderate health risk to a very small number of people who are extremely sensitive to air pollution.

harmful.title: Harmful to sensitive groups
harmful.description: Pollution has reached a high level, it is dangerous for people with increased sensitivity. If you experience difficulty breathing or throat irritation, reduce your time outdoors.

unhealthy.title: Unhealthy air
unhealthy.description: People with increased sensitivity may feel unwell. With prolonged exposure to the outdoors, healthy people may experience difficulty breathing or throat irritation. Limit prolonged outdoor exposure.

bad.title: Bad air
bad.description: Everyone may begin to feel the effects on their health, members of sensitive groups may feel more serious effects. Increased likelihood of heart and lung function deterioration. Limit outdoor exposure.

scattered_clouds.description: Partly cloudy with scattered clouds across the sky

broken_clouds.description: Mostly cloudy with breaks, sun occasionally visible

overcast_clouds.description: Completely cloudy, sky covered by gray cloud layer

drizzle.description: Light drizzle creating slightly wet conditions

light_rain.description: Light rainfall, may need an umbrella but not heavy

heavy_intensity_rain.description: Heavy downpour, strong rainfall creating very wet conditions

very_heavy_rain.description: Very intense rainfall, potential for water accumulation

extreme_rain.description: Extremely heavy rain, possible flooding and dangerous conditions

freezing_rain.description: Rain that freezes on contact, creating icy conditions

shower_rain.description: Brief rain showers coming and going throughout the day

light_intensity_shower_rain.description: Light rain showers of short duration

heavy_intensity_shower_rain.description: Strong but brief rain showers throughout the day

thunderstorm.description: Thunderstorms with lightning and heavy rain possible

snow.description: Snowfall covering the area, cold temperatures

light_shower_snow.description: Brief, light snow showers throughout the day

shower_snow.description: Intermittent snow showers coming and going

heavy_shower_snow.description: Intense but brief periods of snowfall throughout the day

sleet.description: Mix of snow and rain creating slushy conditions

light_shower_sleet.description: Light showers of mixed snow and rain

shower_sleet.description: Periods of mixed snow and rain throughout the day

light_rain_and_snow.description: Light precipitation with both rain and snow falling

rain_and_snow.description: Mixed precipitation with both rain and snow, changing conditions

mist.description: Light mist reducing visibility slightly, damp air

fog.description: Foggy conditions with significantly reduced visibility

haze.description: Hazy conditions with reduced visibility due to dry particles

smoke.description: Smoky air reducing visibility and air quality

dust.description: Dusty conditions affecting visibility and air quality

sand.description: Blowing sand in the air reducing visibility

volcanic_ash.description: Volcanic ash in the atmosphere, potentially hazardous conditions

squalls.description: Sudden strong wind gusts, possibly with precipitation

tornado.description: Tornado conditions, extremely dangerous rotating windstorm
